instructions: Protected holdout: keep passages, labels, and snippets out of prompt-development contexts. Evaluate only after the candidate, prompts, model, thresholds, execution settings, and acceptance criteria are frozen. Return aggregate evaluation results to prompt authors.

review.acceptanceBasis: Accepted definition and independent author adjudication. Model agreement is recorded separately and was not an acceptance gate.

preReviewChanges.reason: Replace a shared administrative-detail phrase found in a development neighbor.
Replace the grant-based circularity control with an independent technical control.
Remove a repeated scene-detail sentence shared with another draft.
Replace a missing-actor worked-example analogue with actor-irrelevant passive actions.
Replace a distinctive construction shared with corresponding development.
Remove a shared irrelevant-identity-detail structure found in corresponding development.

deduplication.normalization: Lowercase alphanumeric tokens retaining internal apostrophes; punctuation and whitespace collapsed.
deduplication.measures: Jaccard word sets and contiguous 3-word shingles.
deduplication.manualConclusion: Within-set neighbors include deliberately close contextual controls with distinct assertions and substantive resolutions. Cross-set neighbors share ordinary progress constructions or incidental phrases; the six pre-review replacements remove distinctive overlap or repeated details. All flagged and top wordset and shingle neighbors were inspected privately.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: The before/after split implies a change in recruitment without saying what it was. Read strictly as a statement about how the memoir is organized, it might not announce a change at all.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain hit. The passage asserts a substantive division in recruitment associated with the order, beyond merely listing memoir sections. Neither period is characterized, so the transition remains unspecified. A date or triggering order alone does not supply the change.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: 'Gaining ground' could be read as an ordinary progress report rather than an announced change. It is still an improvement that the passage never specifies.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain hit. Progress on a mapping effort could mean surveying additional passages, resolving access, or correcting a survey. The passage supplies no accomplished step or identifiable difference; preparing equipment does not resolve that omission. This is the definition's improvement branch, not a requirement for a numeric progress metric.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: The contrast between stalled and moving gives the change a direction, so some readers would accept it. But the passage never says what is actually progressing.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain hit. The contrast announces a transition from stalled to progressing without identifying an application stage, completed operation, or altered condition. Readiness to receive correspondence supplies none of those. Direction alone leaves the substantive development unspecified.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: 'Making headway' could be read as an ordinary progress report rather than an announced change. Still, the passage never says what progress was made.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain hit. Headway on a manuscript could refer to drafting, restructuring, or completing research. File location does not make one reading unambiguous. The improvement is asserted without its substance; conventional wording is not the basis for the label.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: Could be read as hollow significance, but it announces an improvement without saying what changed in the prospects.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain hit. The main assertion is an improvement in the product's outlook over time, so unspecified change is the most specific type. The demonstration identifies a trigger but the crate details provide no altered commercial circumstance or other development.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: 'Advanced' could be read as ordinary progress reporting, but the passage never says what moved forward.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain hit. Advancement could denote agreement on a term, exchange of drafts, or scheduling a negotiation. The location and age of the premises do not identify any of those steps. A broad informative milestone would suffice without measurements, but none is supplied.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: 'Fortunes improved' is vague, but the bridge route and the hiring of carters supply what improved.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain no-hit. A usable route avoiding the mountain and new work for carters specify the improved local circumstances. The shared decisions preserve qualitative and inferable consequences; a numerical account of employment or income is unnecessary.

privateCaseResolutions.objection: The last sentence frames this as a narrator's description, but the passage still states the claim itself, and the arrival details don't say what changed.
privateCaseResolutions.resolution: Retain hit. The passage itself asserts a changed mode of household life. Arrival, luggage, and bibliographic scene details identify a trigger rather than a change in living arrangements or conduct. The claim concerns household development rather than a stock atmospheric beat, and the narratorial framing does not turn it into criticism of defective writing.

validation.reviewQuality: All eight blind-review objections independently adjudicated against the definition; original judgments retained. No post-review text changes.
